name: AnotherWhere
detailed_description:
A FIRST-PERSON PARKOUR MYSTERY ADVENTURE

Vanished without a trace. Explore an abandoned city where you are not alone.

As photojournalist Alo, you return to your childhood home—Chendao, a once-sprawling metropolis that, overnight, became an abandoned exclusion zone. In this single-player adventure, you're armed with nothing but her camera and parkour abilitiesas Alo traverses the procedurally generated city to uncover the truth behind its abandonment and the crimson mist that hovers over the streets.

GAMEPLAY

Pure Investigation - No weapons, no enemies, no combat. Your camera is your tool, evidence is your ammunition. Every photograph reveals another piece of Chendao's final story. Document strange phenomena, collect visual proof, and build a case that challenges the official narrative.

Urban Parkour - To reach the city's center, Alo must master a fluid traversal system. Use wall-running, precision jumping, grappling hooks, and advanced movement abilities to reach every corner of the abandoned metropolis. Discover new traversal abilities that unlock previously inaccessible areas and photo opportunities.

Procedural Cityscape - Each district is procedurally generated while maintaining key story locations. Chendao feels different every time you explore it, but the mystery remains consistent. The city may be empty of people, but it's full of secrets.

Survive and Explore - On her journey, Alo must not only search for clues but also gather resources and food. Manage your supplies, establish safe camps, and plan your routes carefully. Your camps become crucial rest and respawn points as you venture deeper into the city's heart.

A Crimson Mystery - That red fog isn't just an atmospheric phenomenon—it is central to Chendao's abandonment. Stay alert and ready to run when it appears in the streets. But you can't flee forever—the answers Alo seeks lie within those red wisps.

YOUR STORY TO TELL

Alo left Chendao as a child, but part of her never left at all. Now she's back with questions about her missing family and a journalist's instinct that the official story doesn't add up. Working for a small underground newspaper, she carries a traditional token from her father—a reminder of the culture and family she left behind. Driven by the need to uncover what really led to the mysterious vanishing of an entire population, she wanders through dark alleys, climbs crumbling buildings, and leaps across abandoned rooftops on her journey to Chendao's center district. Every empty street, every abandoned apartment, every strange photograph brings her closer to understanding what really happened here.

This isn't about saving the world or fighting monsters. It's about one person with a camera, trying to document a truth that powerful people want forgotten. The city of Chendao has a story to tell—if you're willing to listen to it.

KEY FEATURES

  • Chain Complex Parkour Combos: Combine wall-runs, grappling swings, and precision jumps into flowing sequences that feel satisfying to execute.

  • Frame the Perfect Shot: Use camera composition, angles, and timing to capture evidence that reveals story details invisible to casual observation.

  • Explore Abandoned Spaces: Investigate realistic urban environments where personal belongings create an immersive sense of recent abandonment.

  • Plan Expeditions: Balance risk and reward as limited supplies force strategic decisions about which areas to explore and when to retreat.

  • Navigate Procedural Districts: Explore areas created by a powerful city generator, ensuring no two journeys through AnotherWhere are the same.

  • Escape Supernatural Encounters: Use parkour skills to flee from the crimson fog when investigation turns dangerous, creating tension without traditional combat.

  • Uncover Family Connections: Follow personal leads about Alo's missing relatives while building a case against the official evacuation story.s

  • Unlock Vertical Progression: Gain new movement abilities that allow for faster travel and open up hidden areas and previously unreachable locations.

  • Explore Six Districts: Journey through diverse areas of Chendao, each with unique environmental challenges and story revelations.

  • 8 Hours of Content: A substantial single-player adventure focused entirely on investigation, parkour, and storytelling without combat.

short_description: An entire city of thousands gone overnight, leaving only crimson smoke drifting through empty streets. As Alo, you return to your childhood home of Chendao to uncover the truth in this atmospheric first-person parkour adventure that combines fluid movement with investigative storytelling.
